actions.script: const linkable = recordEntity && recordId && recordEntity !== 'mantle.work.effort.WorkEffort' const out = ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.projects.WorkItemServices.quickAdd#WorkItem').parameters({rootWorkEffortId: rootWorkEffortId || null, workEffortName: workEffortName || '', purposeEnumId: purposeEnumId || null, priority: priority || null, assignToPartyId: assignToPartyId || (assignToMe === 'Y' ? ec.user.userAccount?.partyId : null), estimatedCompletionDate: estimatedCompletionDate || null, sprintWorkEffortId: sprintWorkEffortId || null, recordEntity: linkable ? recordEntity : null, recordId: linkable ? recordId : null}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {workEffortId: out.workEffortId, url: out.url, messageInfos: [{type: 'success', message: out.message, link: out.url}]})

const options = ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.projects.PlanningServices.get#SprintOptions').parameters({rootWorkEffortId: rootWorkEffortId || null}).call()?.optionList || [] ec.web.sendJsonResponse(Array.from(options).map((option) => ({value: option.key, label: option.text})))

const out = ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.projects.TimeServices.save#TimeEntry').parameters({workEffortId: timeWorkEffortId || null, day: day || null, hours: hours || null, billable: billable === 'Y' ? 'Y' : 'N', workTypeEnumId: workTypeEnumId || null, comments: comments || null}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {timeEntryId: out.timeEntryId, messageInfos: [{type: 'success', message: out.message, link: '/qapps/Projects/Time/MyTime?weekDate=' + encodeURIComponent(day || '')}]})
